service.description: The time behind ACME's actual hours, by the real path (mantle.work.TimeServices.store#TimeEntry, each as its person at a time in the past, so the rates are found and the items' actual hours roll up from it), dated from the week the data is loaded (Monday weeks): Joe Developer on ACME-1 (16 h, four days of 4 h) and ACME-3 (7 h) three weeks back, Bob Developer on ACME-2 (9 h) four weeks back; each item's actual hours then equal what the demo set. Each part on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on. Loading again adds nothing when ACME-1 already has time.
